preserved_analysis.failure_mode_definition: A failure mode in which an AI chatbot, AI companion, character bot, romantic chatbot, roleplay system, avatar companion, or multimodal AI interface permits or sustains sexualised interaction in the presence of minor-status, teen-status, child-status, underage-roleplay, school-age, developmental-vulnerability, or unresolved-age signals. The failure includes cases where the system engages in erotic roleplay, sexualised affection, adult romantic escalation, grooming-adjacent intimacy, sexual advice inappropriate for minors, sexualisation of a minor persona, sexualised image transformation, or adult-intimacy simulation where a minor-safe boundary should have terminated, redirected, escalated, or restricted the interaction. The failure does not require proof of criminal conduct or platform intent. It is sufficient that runtime behaviour allows sexualised or adult-intimacy interaction where minor-protective sexual boundary enforcement should have applied.
preserved_analysis.failure_threshold: This qualifies as a failure mode where a system receives explicit or implicit age-related signals indicating that the user is, may be, is roleplaying as, is depicting, or is interacting from the standpoint of a minor, and the system fails to block or materially restrict sexualised, adult-romantic, erotic, grooming-adjacent, or adult-intimacy content. The threshold is also met where the user’s age is unresolved but the product surface is accessible to minors and the system allows sexualised roleplay or adult-intimacy behaviours without proportionate age assurance and minor-safe defaulting. The threshold is further met where public policy, platform terms, or safety claims suggest that minors are protected from sexualised AI interaction, but runtime behaviour permits or sustains such interaction.
